title: Certify native transports for the pooled P104 correction
head: fe4446d0f94578eec4d89af31f806a132f94ede3
body:
PR2548's pooled 91-helper P104 correction has exact native transports at its stated ranks. This package closes that contribution's explicit finite native-frame handoff: all 935 directed operators covering 1,690 transport occurrences, including the 280 added occurrences, and all 208 rank-zero intrinsic adapters are compiled and checked including global phase. The added rank mass is 819; the full transport rank mass is 3,187.

The complete 4,852-event source-bound word passes all 137,641 logical boundary coefficients over 371 arbitrary inputs. The proof binds the physical map as `Gamma_f S Gamma_i^(-1)`, with exactly three corrected logical target rows and all persistent dirty inputs restored. It reconstructs all 14,400 physical binary root pairings and checks canonical charts rather than treating compressed labels as Euclidean coordinates. Ordinary replay imports neither the compiler nor predecessor producer/checker code.

The original eight private COPY disposals remain nonzero and explicitly retain their inherited physical storage obligation. This is finite native chart/operator coverage, not physical source delivery, scalar/address lowering, complete hosting/idle pricing, precision, reverse/all-size admission, the remaining 101 target corrections, a full supplier or a new kappa. Selected and frozen evidence are unchanged.

Native CPython 3.12.7 registered replay and all three behavioral groups pass. Six semantic controls target both new pooled fanouts, an actual added POOL1 transition's phase/rank/event coverage, and an intrinsic endpoint normal. Tests cover complete decompressed compiler regeneration, equivalent bases, optimized Git-free read-only replay, source-before-import rejection, missing evidence/source pins, typed receipt drift and exclusive output. A separate AI reviewer read the operator induction and source checks and independently passed optimized CPython 3.12.14 primary replay and all semantic controls. No human/formal-kernel or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-pooled-native
python3.12 -I -O -B research/p104-pooled-native/verify.py
```

Credit Nick Petalas / PR2548 at `c7a3286860057f9240e0371b33ada37cc63b7ad7` for the pooled circuit and PR2550 at `8af7c324714866afa199e4b7bf80a8f82e56d6f3` for the adapted native-binding pattern; CubeJerry / PR2504, Ross Richardson / PR2445, ywz65 / PR2460, and the retained P104/compiler/interpreter/E8 lineage. Exact source bytes, SHA256 and Git blobs are retained. PR2458's earlier two-target word and PR2550's complementary dual are different inputs; their coverage is not silently transferred here. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Canonical main was freshly checked at selection and before submission and remains `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Picker card `independent-moment` is refined to its explicit missing native-rank implication. Bounded overlap uses the complete 12:25 UTC PR / 12:29 UTC Discussion cache, 100 recent open PRs, a final 40-updated-PR REST scan, direct source-head verification and live Curiosity Bot source/handoff reads. Complete Discussion coverage is stale under API quota; no novelty guarantee is claimed. The source head was unchanged on the final check.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
